# scripts/hardcoded_strings_allowlist.txt
#
# P6.4 — Allowlist for hardcoded English strings.
#
# Files listed here are exempt from the hardcoded strings check.
# Add files that legitimately need hardcoded English strings:
#   - Error messages that are developer-facing only
#   - Debug screens
#   - Generated files (already excluded by pattern)
#   - Test utility widgets
#
# Format: one file path per line (relative to Daxelo-Kinrel-App/)
# Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# To allowlist a specific line: path/to/file.dart:lineNumber

# === Error / debug screens ===
lib/core/utils/error_boundary.dart
